newsitem.title: GERMANY: German seen hovering around 2,700, watching U.S..
newsitem.headline: German seen hovering around 2,700, watching U.S..

text.p: German shares were expected to continue to consolidate over the coming days and hover around the record high levels reached in the last few weeks.
The IBIS DAX electronic trade index was down 6.66 points at 2,698.99. The DAX closed down 11.47 points at 2,691.17.
After so many consecutive record highs, dealers said a period of consolidation was a healthy sign and said the day's weakness was not the beginning of a reversal.
"We can slide a little bit or move sideways over the next few days and then take another run up beyond 2,700 points," said one trader.
